newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI index extends gains for 5th day.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI index extends gains for 5th day.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose for the fifth day in a row, closing 0.38 percent higher on Tuesday, but traders said gains were likely to be short-lived.
"Prices fell too much over a short period so today's rise can still be seen as a technical rebound, but I can't see any reason for a further rise," one broker said.
* The SBI index rose 4.65 points to 1,228.3.
* Drug maker Lek was the most active, easing 0.43 percent to 22,900 tolars on volume of 775 shares for total turnover of 17.9 million tolars.
* Brokerage Dadas was the top gainer, jumping 8.30 percent to 7,700 tolars on volume of only 21 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
